verdict.rationale: User-defined automation rules are a fair question for a business-services SaaS platform like LegalZoom, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only vendor-defined alerts and reminders, such as mail-arrival alerts, compliance notifications and annual-report deadline emails. These are adjacent fixed notifications, not user-configurable rules that trigger actions on events. Nothing in the pack documents a rule builder, triggers, or event-to-action automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
